newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese shares end higher on position squaring.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese shares end higher on position squaring.

text.p: 1615 GMT - Portuguese shares ended higher as investors squared positions before the end of the semester, dealers said. They noted buying interest in the banking sector, notably Banco Pinto e Sotto Mayor, BCP, Banco Totta e Acores and Portugal Telecom, among others. European bourses ended higher, while Wall Street was highly volatile. EDP dropped below 3,200 escudos for the first time since it was listed on the bourse, falling as low as 3,150. Dealers noted profit taking in EDP and said that the stock adjusted to yesterday's lower close in New York. Turnover in the cash market was 22 billion escudos. Dealers said they expected the market to rise again tomorrow as investors squared positions ahead of the end of the semester.
